learning_outcomes.text: Application of scientific principles using the example of the centrifugal pump.

The fluid and thermodynamic as well as machine engineering problems occurring in centrifugal pumps should be reliably recognized, described, evaluated and solved, and well-founded own judgments derived therefrom.
Independently recognize interface problems and the interaction of disciplines.
Students are able to present, deliver, and discuss their theoretical knowledge in oral or written presentations.

syllabus_topics: Conservation laws - mass, momentum, energy for incompressible flows
Pressure loss calculation in piping systems
Fluid mechanics of the nozzle and diffuser
Constructive design of various types of centrifugal pumps
Operating behavior and characteristic curves of centrifugal pumps
Energy losses in a centrifugal pump
Calculation of the necessary delivery head of a piping system
Influence of different fluids on pump behavior
Constructive design of a centrifugal pump: drive, casing, impeller
Distinction between centrifugal pumps and other pump types (e.g., piston pump)
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
